beaches.name: Sarakiniko (Gavdos)
beaches.summary: The municipality banned nudism on Sarakiniko with signs in July 2023. The mayor told the press (1 July 2023) that the ban follows complaints and applies to no other beach; the signs were torn down and re-erected repeatedly that summer, and a June 2024 press piece quotes the municipality that the ban still stands. A naturist directory carries visitor reports of widespread nudity here from 2011 to 2020, all pre-dating the ban.

beaches.name: Agios Ioannis (Gavdos)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix across the whole beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2005 to 2020 putting nudity at 70-100%; in July 2023 the mayor said the Sarakiniko ban applies to no other beach, and a June 2024 press report quotes the municipality that nudism is permitted on ten other beaches. No signage is documented.
